content:
Upgrading to a new iPhone often comes with a hidden cost: having to replace your case when the dimensions change.

For anyone upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, that would seem like a reasonable expectation—but two accessory makers don't think so, and one of them is betting big on it...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case already on sale at Best Buy, noting that it's compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom-right corner of the packaging reads, in English and French:

Fits iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself isn't entirely convinced, commenting "a bit early." But Matt Ronge of Astropad—maker of anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones—says his suppliers are telling him the same thing.

Reports on iPhone Pro thickness are conflicting

Last year, a leaker claimed the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be at least thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but materials leaked from an iPhone supplier suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimeters thicker than its predecessor.

This trend looks set to continue, as both iPhone 17 Pro models were thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

Not all leakers agree, however, with some saying the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide dimensions to long-standing case makers early so that third-party cases are available when new iPhones launch. On the other hand, there have also been cases where accessory makers simply bet on the rumors—and sometimes get it wrong. Personally, I wouldn't pre-order any case before a new iPhone is officially announced.
